(Japanese: '''ギバン島''' ''Giban Island'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive island in [[Hoenn]] that appeared in ''[[AG112|Showdown At Linoone]]''. It is located somewhere between [[Sootopolis City]] and {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}. [[Kimmy Shoney]] lives there with his parents [[Korban and Harmony Shoney|Korban and Harmony]].

The island features a large square mountain and is covered in dense forest. It also has a [[Pokémon Center]].

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} boarded a ship to Giban Island, hoping the stop would be a good location for Ash to train for the upcoming [[Ever Grande Conference]], and for {{an|May}} to train for her next {{pkmn|Contest}}. The group ultimately got little {{pkmn|training}} in, however, after a {{p|Linoone}}, [[nickname]]d Tokin, stole two of May's {{i|Poké Ball}}s due to its habit of {{a|Pickup|picking up}} random [[item]]s.
